value: Law no. 89-462 of 6 July 1989 governs residential leases (main residence).
One month of rent excluding charges; fixed in the lease and not increasable during the lease or at renewal. Where rent is paid quarterly in advance a deposit is prohibited.
Two months of rent excluding charges for a furnished lease; no deposit for a mobility lease.
Deposit must be returned within one month of the tenant handing back the keys; late return adds 10 percent of monthly rent per month started.

Unfurnished lease: rent may be revised once a year only if the lease contains a clause, using the INSEE Rent Reference Index (IRL). Revision is barred in mainland France for leases signed, renewed or tacitly renewed since 24 August 2022 for dwellings rated F or G.
Landlord may end the lease only at its expiry and only to sell, to reoccupy, or for a legitimate and serious reason; the tenant must receive notice at least six months before expiry.
At least three months before expiry, for the same permitted reasons.
Unfurnished: three years minimum; furnished: one year (nine months for a student tenant).
A DPE is required for lettings and is attached to the lease so the tenant is informed about energy costs; dwellings used under four months a year and some small independent units are excluded.
